rule: External/runtime gates are never promoted to PASS without actual execution evidence from the required environment.

gates.reason: Requires pinned LangGraph + SQLite checkpoint runtime execution. Static/source acceptance does not substitute for actual StateGraph checkpoint/resume evidence.
Requires real Streamlit/Python browser rendering through RUN_UI_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE.ps1 on the Owner environment.
Requires the Owner primary-screen resolution and real rendered UI evidence.
Requires the full runtime dependency stack and one-click ModelLab/tools/research/RUN_RESEARCH_E2E.cmd execution.
Requires real onnx/onnxruntime conversion and inference parity execution.
PatchTST/iTransformer/TFT real ONNX export and onnxruntime parity require the Owner runtime toolchain.
Launcher must detect NVIDIA, install the pinned CUDA PyTorch stack, and execute an actual CUDA tensor probe; silent CPU fallback is not accepted when NVIDIA is detected.
CUDA training/runtime for supported temporal families must be accepted on the Owner GPU environment.
Requires MetaEditor on the Owner MT5 environment.
Requires actual same-broker MetaTrader5 reconciliation and Strategy Tester first-write-wins gap repair evidence.
Requires real Owner MT5 terminal/live plus Strategy Tester runtime evidence.
Requires real MetaEditor compile, native MT5 optimization report, R-accounting sidecar parity, and Strategy Challenger export evidence.

Requires actual Owner MT5 native M5/M15/H1/H4 bars for one exact broker/symbol/window. The MTF-1 closure contract archives those raw inputs, replays canonical resampling/parity/alignment/DQ/lineage, and production verification re-fetches the same Owner MT5 window and requires native-input identity.

Requires actual MT5 Python runtime provenance and terminal_info().data_path resolving to a verified terminal data root containing MQL5; MTF-1 closure evidence is closure-run-bound and live-revalidated, while raw drive roots/unverified paths fail closed.

Requires actual MetaEditor compilation of the exact canonical Max_MTF.mq5 on the Owner Windows/MT5 toolchain. The MTF-1 closure verifier verifies the current configured MetaEditor executable/hash and size, exact command/source/deployed MQ5 identity, the exact signed subprocess process_returncode as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY evidence matching the archived process record, a freshly reparsed zero-error compiler log identifying the expected source, and a fresh binary-like EX5 whose archived mtime is inside the compile execution window for the same closure_run_id. Compile PASS is reconstructed from log + fresh EX5 + execution provenance; process return code alone is not semantic compile authority.
MTF-1 is data authority only; MTF strategy execution is intentionally not implemented or activated until later phases.

requirement_semantics: requirement is the immutable phase obligation; runtime PASS exists only in candidate-bound execution evidence. MTF-1 production verifiers replay archived raw artifacts, revalidate current configured external tools/runtime, and bind all closure evidence to one closure_run_id.
